scenario: [LNLS.3.3], the singleton declared second. The keyed pattern comes first and the singleton after it; the anchor still pins the keyed side's full key to a slot of the singleton (`m.addr == cpu.pcf`). A new `Cpu` fact finds at most one token, the one whose `Mem` key it names; a new `Mem` token finds at most one `Cpu`. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.lnls_3_3_anchors`, the singleton arm taken with the singleton on the right.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Cpu scope logical:
    pcf: Int mutable

schema Mem scope logical:
    addr: Int key
    amount: Int mutable

rule fetch:
    Mem m
    Cpu cpu where m.addr == cpu.pcf
->
    log info "fetch"
